name: Hualien Wow Hostel
detail: Price: Very cheap Location: In front of Hualien Railway Station. The Hualien Bus Terminal is also nearby. It is 2.4 km to Dongdamen Night Market, but it's within walking distance while exploring the city. You can also take a bus within the city. Facilities: I stayed in a 4-person room on the 4th floor, and the bed space was spacious; I could change clothes while standing on the bunk bed. There is a locked locker next to the bed. The toilet inside the room is also spacious and separated from the shower room, so the floor doesn't get wet. The shared area on the second floor is spacious and has plenty of charging outlets. Breakfast (toast, ham, cheese, jams, corn, nuts, etc.) was plentiful. The only improvement point is that the air conditioning in the room could not be adjusted, so it was quite cold.

name: Dumbo Hostel Hualien
detail: It is close to Hualien Station. There are convenience stores and dining places nearby, so you won't have any trouble with shopping or meals. Since it is close to the station, it is very convenient for those who want to go straight to the accommodation after arriving in Hualien by train or bus, or for those who want to go to the station immediately after checking out. Also, during my stay, breakfast was included. It was delicious. There is a kitchen, living room, and bookshelf on the first floor that you can use freely, so it's possible to work late into the night. Coffee, tea, and a water dispenser are available for free use. The beds and linens were clean. The shower is equipped with hot water, shampoo, and soap. There is also plenty of toilet paper. A dresser and hairdryer are available as well. There is a designated smoking area outside, which should be convenient for smokers. I highly recommend it for those who prefer to stay near the station.

name: HUALIEN TOONG MAO RESORT
detail: It is somewhat distant from Hualien Station, and I think it would be difficult to access without a car. There is nothing around, but it has a resort hotel feel. There is both a bathtub and a shower. The room is spacious with twin beds. If you finish your meals and stay, you can relax. It takes about 15 minutes by car to get to the city center.

name: Sleeping Boot Hostel
detail: The location is about a ten-minute walk from the station, which isn't too far. The staff at the front desk are very nice, patiently and eagerly helping with many inquiries and chatting with us, remembering each guest. They clean and tidy the hostel every day after guests leave, and overall it is very clean. The hostel has complete facilities, with the kitchen, laundry room, bathrooms, and toilets in separate spaces, and the rooms have balconies for drying clothes with plenty of sunlight. A thoughtful touch is that both the shoe-changing area and toilets have alcohol spray for disinfection. The common areas also have many Hualien guides and maps, which is very convenient. There is no elevator, so it's advisable not to bring large luggage. I did, and felt embarrassed asking the front desk staff to carry it up. 🙈 The privacy in the top bunk isn't very good, as it isn't completely covered, making it inconvenient to take and store items. The bottom bunk is better in this regard. Overall, I am very satisfied!

name: Charming City Hotel Hualien
detail: The long-established chain hotel provides five-star level excellent service, with warm and comfortable soft sofas, a quiet and convenient spacious and bright decor. The overall design of the Hualien marble lobby is refreshing, and the rooms are clean and neat with double sinks and a separated wet and dry area. The housekeeping staff is very professional and attentive to cleaning and organizing. Whether at the front desk, housekeeping, or restaurant, all the staff members have a very friendly attitude. I highly recommend the long-established Xiangcheng Hotel.

name: Corner House
detail: Convenient location, clean space, the bed mattress is indeed a bit thin, but I still slept very well. And especially thanks to the host, she is very friendly and even let me check in early. Thank you for the wonderful trip in Hualien.

name: Cozy House Hostel
detail: A small house located about a 10-minute walk from the train station. The room is small but suitable for a solo traveler to stay. There are shared bathrooms on each floor with good hot water pressure. Cleanliness is good, and most cooking utensils and dishes are provided. Above all, the staff is friendly.

name: Kindness Hotel Hualien
detail: The location is great, about a 5-minute walk from Hualien Station. In particular, the male staff member who explained the surrounding attractions during check-in was very kind. Thanks to him, I was able to rent a bicycle and enjoy food tours and sightseeing around the city. Both breakfast and the supper (which was more like a hotel dinner buffet!) were delicious, and I ended up eating too much. Even the beer was free! It's amazing. The coffee and other amenities available 24 hours were also nice. The room was spacious, clean, and the bed was very comfortable. There were more than ten washing machines and dryers available, so I could use them without any waiting time. Rather than going to Hualien, I would want to visit Hualien again just to stay at this wonderful hotel.

name: Meci Hotel
detail: Just like the online reviews, this hotel with a high cost-performance ratio is very nice and worth the price! The staff's service attitude is excellent. It's a 5-minute walk from Hualien Station, and the room is just the right size, very clean. During the day, you can see the green mountains and white clouds through the small window, and at night, you can see the vibrant stadium. It feels great! This place is really good!
